title: Build resume upload form with drag-and-drop and progress indication
acceptance_criteria: Drag-and-drop zone with file type indicators (PDF, DOCX, DOC)
File type validation on client side before upload begins
Upload progress bar showing percentage complete
Presigned POST flow: client gets presigned URL, uploads directly to DO Spaces
Success state with file preview (name, size, upload date)
Error handling: file too large, wrong type, upload failure with retry option
Responsive: works on mobile with touch support
